title: Run Suite Intelligence resident loop
description: Run the foreground resident intelligence loop. It scans workspace state, self-checks wiring, ranks next tasks, uses the configured local DeepSeek pilot state and only calls a cloud planner when explicitly enabled on a throttle, and writes state/events until stopped by the operator. Disabled by default; set NORTHSTAR_SUITE_INTELLIGENCE_ENABLED=1 and NORTHSTAR_SUITE_INTELLIGENCE_AUTOSTART=1 to opt in.
